The Linesman functions as a data collector for referee validation. This structure ensures minimal information leakage through defined jurisdiction boundaries. Failure modes include referee override of umpire decisions or lack of linesman testimony, leading to inconsistent game states. The system's robustness depends on clear separation of duties and mutual verification protocols.
